entries.text: What if every dream you have is a memory from another life?
You've never seen your own face, only reflections and photographs.
The voice in your head has been speaking your whole life, but you've never heard it.
Every person you dream of, you've seen at some point in your life.
You are the universe experiencing itself.
What if oxygen is slowly killing us and takes 75-100 years?
You can't remember the beginning of your dreams.
The present is already the past by the time you perceive it.
Your skeleton is wet right now.
Somewhere, someone's best day ever is happening right now.
You are made of atoms that were once inside stars.
Every decision creates a new universe in the multiverse.
The word 'bed' looks like a bed.
Nothing is on fire. Fire is on things.
You've been the youngest person in the world for a brief moment.
Your future self is watching you through memories.
We are all time travelers, moving at one second per second.
The stars you see might no longer exist.
Silence is the loudest sound.
Every mirror you've looked into, remembers your face.
Dreams might be glimpses into parallel universes.
You are someone's reason to smile.
The moon watches you sleep.
Thoughts are just voices without sound.
Time moves faster when you're not watching.
